page_title: TOU 0-1 PSG | Toulouse v PSG 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+1' That will be all from Senny Mayulu who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Joao Neves (PSG).
90' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
86' PSG enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
83' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Goncalo Ramos picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
79' Here comes a substitution. Shavy Babicka is given a rest as he is replaced by Noah Edjouma (Toulouse).
79' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) replaces Umit Akdag.
79' The ball is cleared after Ousmane Dembele (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
77' A dangerous towering header by Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
76' Corner kick. Toulouse will have an opportunity.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Goncalo Ramos (PSG) comes onto the pitch so that Bradley Barcola can be given a rest.
73' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
72' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Toulouse can continue in their attacking effort.
70' Here's the change. Vincent Sierro leaves the pitch and Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.
70' Here is a change. Frank Magri is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Rafik Messali (Toulouse).
69' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
67' A corner kick by Toulouse is thwarted by the well prepared Matvey Safonov (PSG).
63' It's time for a substitution. Ousmane Dembele (PSG) comes on in place of Kang-In Lee.
63' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Willian Pacho and he is replaced by Marquinhos (PSG).
63' The referee signals a substitution. Vitinha (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Fabian Ruiz.
63' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.

62' He should have scored! Bradley Barcola (PSG) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Kjetil Haug makes an easy save.
61' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
60' Desire Doue (PSG) gets to a rebound in the six-yard box and his effort smashes off the right post.

59' Nice move, nice attempt! Kang-In Lee (PSG) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
56' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Umit Akdag (Toulouse) for a tough tackle.
52' 0 - 1 Goal! Fabian Ruiz (PSG) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:1.
52' CHANCE! Willian Pacho (PSG) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
52' Kang-In Lee (PSG) prepares to take a corner kick.
52' This shall not pass! Senny Mayulu (PSG) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.

50' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Matvey Safonov was alert and the score remains the same.
48' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

46' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. Toulouse will take a corner kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
43' Carles Martinez is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Guillaume Restes suffers an injury and Kjetil Haug (Toulouse) comes on.
41' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) picks up an injury.
39' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.

38' Bradley Barcola (PSG) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post.
36' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

36' What a sweet touch by Lucas Beraldo (PSG) after latching on to a fine pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and unleashes a cannonball close to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper makes a brilliant save, pushing the ball onto the post.
32' That was close by Bradley Barcola (PSG)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
30' Some great play by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Guillaume Restes sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
27' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
27' Senny Mayulu (PSG) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.

26' Kang-In Lee (PSG) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
24' Umit Akdag (Toulouse) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Willy Delajod stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. PSG are awarded a free kick.
24' Desire Doue (PSG) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
20' Desire Doue (PSG) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
18' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
14' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
14' Toulouse earn a corner.
13' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Toulouse will have a corner.
12' A precise low pass is received by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
11' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is flagged for offside.
11' Senny Mayulu (PSG) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
8' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
4' It looks like Desire Doue (PSG) saw red with that tackle. Willy Delajod won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
2' Frank Magri (Toulouse) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the top of the goal that is easily dealt with by Matvey Safonov.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! PSG will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Willy Delajod.
